cards.name: notes
cards.spec: Free text notes about the customer. Empty by default.

cards.name: is_active
cards.spec: Marks whether the customer is active. Defaults to True.

cards.name: create_sale
cards.spec: create_sale(customer, number, date) creates and returns a new Sale for that customer with total 0. If customer.is_active is False it raises ValueError and creates no Sale.
